how: Halo 3 player configuration (0xB8 bytes, native/h3.cpp: player 0's copied, then these bytes laid over it). Decoded live Oct 24 (tools/look_probe.py bots on High Ground, tools/look_regions.py reading each bot's body: Spartan region permutations one byte every 8 from biped +0x11B0, alphabetical: arms, body, chest, chest_shared, helmet, left shoulder, legs, right shoulder; Elite from +0x1288). The armor bytes are the 8 customized areas of the map's multiplayer_globals in the table's order, each value the selection's index in that area (Oct 28, docs/HANDOFF_armor_oct28.md): Spartan +0x46 helmet (69 selections), +0x47 / +0x48 shoulders (62), +0x49 chest (56), +0x4A arms (33), +0x4B legs (38), +0x4C techsuit (17), +0x4D backpack (26); Elite +0x4E head, +0x4F / +0x50 shoulders, +0x51 chest (17 each), +0x52 arms, +0x53 legs (9 each), +0x54 body (2: legacy, base), +0x55 backpack (1). Read from sandbox, guardian, construct, armory and s3d_edge.map (all the same) and the H3EK kit tag; it matches every live boundary seen (arms 33+ and legs 38+ fall back, techsuit 16 its own piece, backpack 5 a blade on the back = fireaxe, chest 13 the first chest that sets chest_shared, Elite legs value + 1 and Elite shoulders 5-11 exactly). Each area lists 'legacy' (the 2007 pieces: helmet 0-10, shoulders 0-7, chest 0-9, arms / legs / techsuit 0), then MCC's: mp_ (MCC's mesh of an original set), el_ (MCC's H3E pieces), Raven, Belos, Blackguard, Drengr, SPI, Xbox; the 'names' lists name the helmet, shoulder and chest values (the Settings tab's pickers show them); MCC's Belos, Blackguard and Drengr pieces by MCC's own names (its EN_Global strings), each matched to its table piece by renders against Halopedia's icons (Oct 28 night: belos_base = Heran, transverse = Syntrofos; blackguard base = Warfeast, bishop = Fallen Equerry, wind = Carrion Crow; chests base / ornate = Kardia / Lochagos, Banetouched / Margrave, Geirfugl / Vinr; shoulders glory = Lionmarked, straps = Dartbreaker, shield = Valorous, lion = Lionbreaker, dragon = Knight of Verent, wing = Venezia, goat = Aleria, knight = Madrigal, drengr base = Oathbound, horn = Thornbound, wolf = Fangbound, dragon = Scalebound; Belos base / ornate and Blackguard base shoulders carry no name of their own in MCC's strings). Original (owner's list, docs/research/13: helmet, shoulders and chest only; arms, legs, techsuit, backpack at 0): only values that are original under both this table and the Oct 24 reading by MCC's item numbers (helmet 0-7, 9, 10; shoulders 0-6; chest 0, 2-6), so no reading puts an MCC piece on an Original bot; the Oct 24 lists' helmet / shoulder 12 and chest 11 (the table's el_helmet_base, mp_leftshoulder_cqb, el_chest_base) and chest 1 (the 2007 Bungie chest, rolled for every bot before) are out. Live checks (the HANDOFF) would add helmet 8, shoulder 7, chest 7-8. Effects: chest 13 is the Flaming Head seen live (only a bot that wears an effect); chest 1, the 2007 Bungie chest, is an effect too (Modern). Modern: every selection of the table; Elite +0x54 stays 0 (owner, Oct 25: Elites on body 1 lost their chest and leg armor). Colours (30, 0 Steel .. 29 Khaki): primary +0x39 (whole suit, seen), secondary +0x3A (seen), tertiary +0x3B (by position). Model +0x3C: 0 Spartan, 1 Elite (seen; the game clamps it to 0..2). Elite (Oct 28 night): head, shoulders and chest list legacy, legacy_predator, legacy_raptor, legacy_blades, legacy_scythe (the 2007 Combat, Flight, Assault, Ascetic, Commando), base and mp_ (MCC meshes of the same five), el_a9, el_cerronsi, el_coronatum, el_eremias, el_gallotia, el_istirus, el_solare (Series 7: Keepward, Accord, General, Scion, Artisan, Ossoona, Seneschal); arms and legs legacy, base, then the seven. Named by renders of every value against Halopedia set renders and helmet icons (logs/tmp/h3e_orig.png; Accord = Cerronsi, Ossoona = Istirus as Halopedia states). Original: the five 2007 sets on helmet, shoulders and chest (0-4), arms and legs 0. Service tag +0x56 (botcore sets it from the bot's name). Visor +0x6C (found Oct 26 from the owner's own change to Green: 22): MCC's visor list index + 1, the list's order in MCC-Win64-Shipping.exe's H3_VISOR_* names (1 Default, 2 Bronze .. 25 Red, 26-31 Pearl, 32-58 MCC's patterned visors, 58 Tracker); seen on bots Oct 26 evening: 1, 2, 6, 7, 13, 19-23, 25, 26, 30, 40, 47, 51, 56, 58 each its own visor; a lineup with 59 (past the list) froze MCC's drawing, so 58 is the end. Original: the default (MCC added the colours). The Spartan bytes +0x46-0x49 move no Elite region.
